messages:
Maya: morning — quick rollcall. what I did: merged PR #1849 (dynamic slotting) and landed unit tests for scheduler fairness. blocked: seeing p95 regressions on long-tail requests when microbatching is disabled. today: run targeted perf bench and dig into KV eviction pattern after microburst.

Liam: saw the same blip on canary. quick smokebench: p95 went 43ms -> 129ms at seq=2048 when cache cold. command I used: `./bench/run --model=gpt-small --seq=2048 --concurrency=8`

Anika: seeing similar in shard-b logs. adding extra logging to capture KV miss_rate and eviction_msgs. filing issue #4022 for tracking. suggestion: try enabling prefix caching for long-tail flows.

Soren: pushed a tiny loop-hotfix to the kernel (reduce per-token syscall). @Maya can you kick canary-3 with that patch?

Maya: kicking canary-3 now. attaching quick log excerpt: ```
[4623450060] [kv] miss_rate=0.32 evicts=12 p95=128ms
[4623450065] [kernel] loop_overhead=0.9ms
```

Diane: re-running batcher-tune with adaptive window param change (window_ms 6 -> 4). local sim shows ~6-8% p95 improvement on short bursts.

deploy-bot: Canary deployed to shard-a at 4623450120

Maya: canary run finished. cold p95 improved from 122ms -> 85ms after hotfix + batcher tweak. warm p95 ~36ms. moving to a broader canary across 3 shards. :thumbsup:

Liam: nice. blocker for full rollout: we need a regression test in the microburst harness to ensure no regression on <10ms tails — tagging @Anika.

Anika: will add a pytest that simulates rapid short-lived requests (microburst) and asserts KV hit_rate > 70% within 30s. aiming to land EOD.

Soren: logged an experiment to bump batching backpressure threshold to 6ms (was 5ms). hoping it reduces jitter from queue fills. will post numbers.

Maya: follow-ups: I'll open a doc PR with canary steps + bench commands I ran, and request a dedicated bench pod for long runs tomorrow.

Anika: ping me on the PR, will review before EOD.

Diane: if the shard-wide canary looks good, I'll schedule a short maintenance window to roll the rest overnight.

Maya: no other urgent asks from me. marking this thread as the daily rollcall.
